title: Diffusion-Based Inverse Design of Dielectric Resonator Metasurfaces for Shaping Smart Electromagnetic Environments
abstract: arXiv:2608.29907v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Future wireless systems are expected to transform the surrounding space from a passive propagation medium into a smart electromagnetic environment, where engineered surfaces control wave propagation, support wireless sensing, and create programmable electromagnetic fingerprints. A key challenge in realizing this vision is the inverse design of metasurfaces for tailored electromagnetic propagation. While forward analysis evaluates the response of a known geometry, the inverse task starts from a prescribed scattering signature and seeks a physically realizable structure that produces it. This inverse task is inherently nonlinear and often high-dimensional, while candidate solutions may be non-unique and provide no direct indication of practical realizability. Here, we introduce a conditional diffusion framework for inverse design of dielectric resonator metasurfaces from target angular scattering patterns. Trained on T-matrix simulated geo

translated_title: 基于扩散模型的介质谐振器超表面逆向设计，用于塑造智能电磁环境
translated_abstract: 未来的无线通信系统有望将周围空间从被动的传播介质转变为智能电磁环境，在这种环境中，工程化表面能够控制波的传播、支持无线感知，并创建可编程的电磁指纹。实现这一愿景的一个关键挑战是针对定制电磁传播的超表面逆向设计。正向分析评估的是已知几何结构的响应，而逆向任务则是从给定的散射特征出发，寻找能够产生该特征的物理可实现结构。这一逆向任务本质上是非线性的且通常是高维的，同时候选解可能是非唯一的，并且无法直接指示其实际可制造性。本文提出了一种条件扩散框架，用于从目标角度散射图样出发对介质谐振器超表面进行逆向设计。该框架在T矩阵模拟的几何数据上训练（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于条件扩散模型的逆向设计框架，能够从目标角度散射图样出发设计介质谐振器超表面，从而实现智能电磁环境的塑造。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a conditional diffusion framework for the inverse design of dielectric resonator metasurfaces from target angular scattering patterns, enabling the shaping of smart electromagnetic environments.
